integrity: Two independently programmed complete finite functional-graph enumerations agree on all joint histograms and basin-size multiplicities; an independent direct wave-symmetry check verifies the 13-period geometry. All source and data files needed to replay are included. No external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for one undirected 13-vertex Paley graph and three-state threshold-two/three excitation only; no all-size Paley graph theorem. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
title: Six affine thirteen-waves and a sharp contact-threshold collapse on the Paley graph of order thirteen
